words.def: To ride is to sit on something and go along on it, like a bike, a scooter or a horse.
ask: What do you like to ride – a bike, a scooter, a horse?
words.sentence: I like to ride my bike to the park.
words.adultDef: to sit on something and make it move, like a bike or a horse.

words.def: Like means you enjoy something. If you like pizza, pizza makes you happy!
ask: What is something you really like?
words.adultDef: to enjoy something or think it is good.

words.def: Nine is a number. It comes after eight and before ten.
ask: Can you show me nine fingers?
words.sentence: My little brother is nine years old.
words.adultDef: the number 9 – one more than eight.

words.def: Time tells us when things happen. A clock shows us the time.
ask: What time do you go to bed?
words.sentence: It is time to pack up and go home.
words.adultDef: what the clock tells us – or a moment when something happens ("It is time to go!").

words.def: A bike has two wheels and a seat. You push the pedals with your feet to make it go.
ask: Where do you like to ride your bike?
words.sentence: I wear my helmet when I ride my bike.
words.adultDef: a bicycle – it has two wheels and pedals that you push with your feet.

words.def: A kite is a light toy that flies high in the sky on a long string when the wind blows.
ask: Have you ever flown a kite?
words.sentence: We flew a kite at the beach on a windy day.
words.adultDef: a toy made of cloth or paper on a long string that flies in the wind.
